title: [Shopify] Keep gift cards from unverified POS returns on the sales invoice
summary: Modified Shopify gift card handling on POS unverified returns so they remain on sales invoices rather than being treated as exchange items, preventing empty invoice generation with auto-release enabled.
key_points: Gift cards on unverified POS returns now treated as regular order lines instead of exchange items
Prevents invoices from becoming empty when no exchange items remain on credit memos
Order import now sets Is Exchange Item for every line during write rather than separate marking pass
Refund import skips synthetic exchange refund lines for unverified return gift cards
Added 7 tests validating unverified and verified return handling
quote: A Shopify POS unverified return can only be refunded to a gift card.
